name: HONG KONG MAHJONG
description: Hong Kong Mahjong is a four-player Cantonese Mahjong variant that emphasizes practical hand building and fan-based scoring. The game uses the standard Mahjong tile set and straightforward meld structure, making it one of the most widely taught regional forms.

content.text: Hong Kong Mahjong is a four-player Cantonese Mahjong variant that emphasizes practical hand building and fan-based scoring. The game uses the standard Mahjong tile set and straightforward meld structure, making it one of the most widely taught regional forms.
Hong Kong Mahjong developed from earlier Chinese Mahjong forms and became the dominant urban Cantonese ruleset through the 20th century.
4 players. Seats are assigned East, South, West, North.
Three suited tile groups 1-9, winds, dragons, flowers and seasons in a standard Mahjong set.
Three suited tile groups 1-9, winds, dragons, flowers and seasons in a standard Mahjong set.
Each player starts with 13 tiles; dealer (East) starts with 14 and discards first.

items.text: Minimum Fan Tables: Different clubs use different minimum fan thresholds to declare a winning hand.
Flowers and Seasons Enabled: Flower and season bonuses are counted according to local table practice.
